ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for taking the time to to share your thoughtful feedback, and for being a loyal Weber customer for so many years. We truly appreciate your continued support. 

We are sorry to hear that some of the design updates have made your experience less convenient, particularly with the ash catcher handle and the lid hook placement. We understand how these changes can be frustrating, especially when ease of use is an important part of the grilling experience. 

Your comments have been shared with our product team, as customer feedback like yours plays an important role in helping us evaluate future product improvements. We appreciate you bringing these concerns to our attention. If there's anything we can assist you with directly, please don't hesitate to reach out to our Support team. Thank you again for your honest feedback and for choosing Weber.

Results.ReviewText: Weber charcoal grills are sturdy and work well.  I have been a Weber charcoal grill user for a couple of decades.  However I bought a new one this spring and two aspects have been redesigned.  The ash catcher now has a handle which has to be squeezed to disengage from its holder.  It is very difficult to squeeze hard enough if your hand strength is diminished in any way.  I can use a pliers to squeeze it hard enough to loosen it, but then I don't have enough hands to squeeze the plier, hold the handle, and position the ash catcher to reposition it.  The handle placement has been rotated so it is less convenient to hook the lid onto the body, although it is still possible.
Results.Title: Redesign is not helpful

Results.ReviewText: Great charcoal grill. Easy-to-use and gives amazing flavors to whatever is cooking.
Results.Title: Excellent charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText: It's works great for my needs!  Cooks to my specifications!
Results.Title: Weber charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: I have owned and used Weber grills for many years. They have cooked many steaks, hamburgers, hots and sausage rain, snow, shine. My small kettles have traveled with me for camping and picnics. Yes, I have had gas grills but nothing comes near to the taste of meat grilled over charcoal. Best of all, with the kettles grills you can smoke meats too, just read the manual and get the smoking kit. Finally as you're grilling, sit back on your porch chair, read or listen to a book as you anticipate a great dinner.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Grills are Great!

Results.ReviewText: Every weekend I cook since I bought it. Grilling gives me pleasure. The ash can be centralized in the bucket, making maintenance easy.
Results.Title: Perfect for grilling everything

Results.ReviewText: A little daunting, but even a 73 year old can do it. Two things. #1, to the jokester who included two washers that weren’t needed, touché. Second, the direction of the basket could have been more clearly stated. I had to take it apart and shift the direction. But all in all ok.
Results.Title: Close to great

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill. Need to read instructions for inserting the clips in the legs carefully as they only work one way. I especially like the clean out feature since I have this on a deck and don’t want to get ashes everywhere.
Results.Title: Nice grill worth the added cost for clean out.

Results.ReviewText: Have weber gas grill and another 22 inch charcoal grill.  Owner over 25 years
Results.Title: Outstanding

Results.ReviewText: I have had my 22" original premium charcoal grill for over 8 years now. I cook on it year round and love it. I would say the best feature of the grill ,but not the only one, is the ability to easily remove charcoal ashes for the next cook. Temperature control is another feature I like. Eventually I will probably replace this one, but because of the quality of your product, I don't see that happening very soon. Thanks again for such a quality product and keep up the good work

The 22” original kettle premium grill is an excellent choice to grill on.
It is so well engineered that it makes grilling to do easy to do. It is also easy to maintain.
With it’s vent system it allows you to maintain the heat from your charcoals to allow you to cook evenly. I got this grill as a gift to me for retirement. I have enjoyed using it every time.
Weber really put the wow in grilling with this grill.
Results.Title: Weber puts the wow in Grilling!

Results.ReviewText: After replacing my old Weber with a couple of others I am glad to back with the original. Stable temperatures, great build quality and properly cooked food make this a winner.
Results.Title: A cut above the rest

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill! It was worth every penny I spent on it. I
Results.Title: I love this grill!

Results.ReviewText: This was a Father's Day gift and my partner couldn't have been more surprised! After HE put everything together, he was so proud of the Weber 22 inch, porcelain -coated grill, table attachment, and cover! We griĺled chicken and hamburgers to celebrate! We love our new grill and sadly retiring the old Weber grill we've had for years!
Results.Title: Daddy's Day Grill

Results.ReviewText: Cooked for 14 people on the 4th of July the Weber grill done great. Got several complaints on how good the burgers and hotdogs were.
Results.Title: 4th of July cookout

Excellent quality and performance! 
SO EASY TO  USE AND MAINTAIN  
ITS MY  GO TO  GRIĹL OF CHOICE  FOR ANY BBQ ING .
Results.Title: First  charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText:
The Weber Kettle is one of those tools that you just can't be without. It works without electricity. You can smoke with it, grill with it, cook everything from skewers to a turkey in it. They do wear out over the years, this is my 4th or 5th. 

Weber continues to improve the ash collector on their Original Kettle model, this one is great. 

I replaced the stock chromed steel grate with a cast iron set to make searing better. 

I also like the new colors offered.
Results.Title: Utility Knife of the Grilling World

Results.ReviewText: There's a reason Weber stands alone. Spome time ago, I bought a look-a-like model. Big Mistake. With my new Weber, I cooked some ribs, low and slow-maintaining proper temperature for the 3 hour cook was a breeze. Ribs were smokey, flavorful and done to perfection.
Results.Title: Meaningful Tradition

Results.Title: Learning curve

Results.ReviewText: This is the Second 22” Original Kettle grill I’ve owned. The first one I had for over 20 years.
Results.Title: Built to Last

Results.ReviewText: I only wish it was taller. I will try to build an easy ramp platform.
Results.Title: A taller profile

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. So sorry to hear about issue with the handle. Our Care team is here to help. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Terrible customer service.  I tried five times emailed and didn’t get any help as to why the handle didn’t fit.  I need it sent back but no one ever responds.  I sent photos too.
Results.Title: Don’t buy a Weber

Results.ReviewText:
This is the second Kettle I've owned, coming back from a KJ2! Super fun and easy to use once you get some grilling time in!

Will forever own a Kettle!

1 Weber gaser and 2 Kettles
Results.Title: I love this Kettle!

Results.ReviewText: I switched to charcoal at the recommendation of my brother from a gas grill to a Weber. Wish I had done it years ago. The Weber delivers just as it says; heat is easy to maintain, the cleanup is not the best, but you can overlook that for the improved taste. Get grilling.
Results.Title: Grilling the pork and burgers.

Results.ReviewText: Love it. Large cooking area. The only think it lacks is something onhtge damper for adjusting. Too hot to touch while cooking.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I always recommend a Weber to all my friends and family, the best grill ever made, my first grill lasted 20 years with no issues, I just replaced it
Results.Title: Weber The one and only Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought my first Weber in 1980, used it for 11 years, bought a house with an installed gas grill. Eventually went back to charcoal grill, however, not a Weber. After many years and various charcoal grills, bought a new Weber. Wow, built in thermometer, new style grate making it easy to add more charcoal if necessary when smoking food and a new way to dispose of the ashes. Excellent modifications!
Results.Title: Reasons to purchase a Weber

Results.ReviewText: Haven't been able to have a charcole grill for years now, have really missed it. Love the ash basket. Makes cleanup alot easier. The temp gage is also a nice plus !!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Our Ohio Homeowner's Association was recently visited by a Webber Representative who noticed that our two coal-based kettle grills required some TLC. He was extremely helpful with getting some parts that were still under warranty and made sure that we received them for the opening of the Gazebo and Pool before Labor Day. Many thanks to Webber for being proactive for its customers! We definitely recommend Webber products due to the company's superior manufacturing and warranties.
Results.Title: Webber Warranty Rocks!

Results.ReviewText: Love my Weber Grill!! I switched to gas a while back and it is not just the same as using the Weber original kettle char l grill. Switched back to the my Weber charcoal grill and I am so glad I did!
Results.Title: Weber grills are the best!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
